title: my_strcat
prompt: Implement `void my_strcat(char *dst, const char *src)` appending src's characters to the END of dst's string (after dst's NUL), then terminating. dst is large enough.

tests.name: append
tests.hint: Find dst's NUL, then copy from there.

tests.name: onto empty
tests.hint: NUL at position 0: append writes at 0.
